Quick Note-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Capture-to-note marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Quick Note workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Quick Note vs generic note-taking

US pages use "Quick Note", "New Quick Note", "Add to Quick Note", or "Save to Notes." China storefront copy often uses 快速备忘录 when referencing Apple's system feature, 随手记一笔 for fleeting capture, or 添加到快速备忘录 for Share sheet actions — depending on whether you mean system Quick Note compatibility, in-app clip-to-note, or reader capture. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual capture scope.

Corner swipe vs Share sheet capture

Screenshot galleries often label two distinct flows: corner swipe (拖动角落记笔记 / 从屏幕角落滑出快速备忘录) and Add to Quick Note from Share sheet (从分享菜单添加到快速备忘录). These signal iPad-first capture vs reader-app clip intent — different from Reminders due-date pickers or Scribble handwriting demos. Match the capture model your English listing and screenshots actually show.

Linked preview vs full note editor

Some apps appear as a linked card inside a system Quick Note — not a standalone note editor. Listing copy should distinguish linked-preview capture from "full Notes replacement" claims unless your English page already makes that scope clear.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need capture search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 快速备忘录, 随手记, and 添加到快速备忘录 each signal different intent from generic 笔记 or 提醒事项 keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Add to Quick Note" headlines on gallery frames — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

Why machine-translated Quick Note copy fails

  • Literal "Quick Note" → awkward 快速笔记 as a product subtitle instead of commerce-idiomatic 快速备忘录
  • Generic "Save to Notes" → 保存到笔记 (vague) instead of 添加到快速备忘录 (Share action buyers recognize)
  • English badge headlines preserved on zh-Hans screenshots — "Add to Quick Note" with no Chinese benefit line beside it
  • Overlay text overflow — long English capture captions pasted into short screenshot callout zones truncate on device
  • Conflating 快速备忘录 with 提醒事项 — buyers searching for corner-swipe capture may not match Reminders due-date keywords
  • Leading with 手写 or Scribble terms when the screenshot shows Share-to-Quick-Note — handwriting vocabulary for a capture workflow
  • Inconsistent vocabulary between listing description, promotional text, and screenshot captions when all three mention Quick Note capture

Machine translation is fine for internal drafts. Finished capture strings need idiomatic zh-Hans that states what Quick Note workflows you ship — while keeping accurate scope. AppLocale rewrites by hand; we do not deliver raw Google Translate or LLM output as finished copy.
